items.title: Trump ratchets up rhetoric against Beijing as U.S.-China officials meet for Xi's Washington visit
items.summary: BEIJING — As the U.S. ramped up pressure this week on China with secondary Iran sanctions, the world's two largest economies have still managed to stay focused on ways to cooperate.

items.title: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh delivers his key Jackson Hole speech Friday. Here's what to expect
items.summary: The Federal Reserve 's cryptic chairman is set to deliver his much-awaited keynote address Friday in Jackson Hole, with markets trying to anticipate what, if anything, he will have to say on key matters affecting the economy and monetary policy.

items.title: Kansas City Fed's Schmid says inflation 'stubborn' and 'sticky,' policy rate not restrictive
items.summary: Kansas City Federal Reserve President Jeffrey Schmid said Thursday that inflation is still too high, though he stopped short of calling for an interest rate hike.

items.title: Fed Chairman Warsh expresses concern about inflation, advocates for 'quieter' central bank
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh expressed concern Friday about elevated inflation while hinting that interest rates could need to move higher if more progress isn't made on easing price pressures.

items.title: Fed's Hammack says 'now is the time to act' on raising interest rates
items.summary: Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack on Thursday repeated her call for higher interest rates, saying recent inflation data shows the central bank is still too far from its goal.
